adds.title: The Brunei Project (est. 2015)
adds.summary: The Brunei Project has monitored human rights in Brunei since May 2015 with LGBTI rights including transgender and intersex rights among its concerns, in May 2016 it held Brunei's first International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia event in collaboration with local LGBTI activists and regional LGBTI organisations, and no independent human rights organisations are active in Brunei.

adds.title: 11 March 2015 Syariah cross-dressing enforcement case
adds.summary: On 17 October 2014 at 10.35pm religious law enforcers caught 38-year-old unmarried Muslim civil servant Roslani Hj Metasan posing as a woman at Bangunan Bumiputera in Bandar Seri Begawan with women's personal items in his bag, and he pleaded guilty to cross-dressing in a public place under Section 198(1) of the Syariah Penal Code Order 2013 and was sentenced to a $1,000 fine with 60 days' imprisonment in default.
